Original detailed cinematic manga for ZERO-SUM: OMEN. Meticulous variable-weight black ink, selective crosshatching and controlled halftone, expressive anatomy and hands, clear perspective, tactile brass machinery and repaired clothing, matte gouache architectural depth, restrained colour accents. Serious action has weight and aftermath; comedy uses stillness and simplified expression. Teen-rated peril, no gore or sexualization. Preserve supplied character identity and asymmetric props. English left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Exact rectangular layout follows the coordinates below, with clean white gutters. Draw NO lettering, numerals, logos, sound effects, speech balloons, captions, HUD or readable signs. Leave quiet upper areas for separate lettering. Every required digit and word is a later vector layer. No imitation of a named artist or existing franchise. NIL uses they/them, RIGHT decoder, one orange hair streak, three abacus clasps, longer LEFT coat tail. Vesper has LEFT braid, two blank hat cards, seven-chamber gun. Varro is human under a repaired hound mask, with three jars. Never mirror these actors.
Colour script: slate rain, bone paper and warm amber brass; signature colour only at the focal actor.
Panel p004_01 at normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.05, 0.43, 0.25]: Macro of cracked RIGHT decoder aligning with brass stop lever, rain on smoked glass. Display blank for exact later overlay.
Panel p004_02 at normalized rectangle [0.52, 0.05, 0.43, 0.25]: Five anatomically clear fingers stop the lever; one taut diagonal motion line ends at latch.
Panel p004_03 at normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.32, 0.9, 0.31]: Large observable transfer: six sparks leave jar, travel through decoder route and enter Ama frame. Jar and Ama visible together; no new sparks appear.
Panel p004_04 at normalized rectangle [0.05, 0.65, 0.9, 0.3]: Ama steadier, Tobi holds her. Collector retains their own untouched frame. NIL broken identity frame remains. Orange settles to small ember.
Use an exact1000x1500 composition grid (scale proportionally to the output). Panel pixel boxes [x,y,w,h]: p004_01 [50, 75, 430, 375]; p004_02 [520, 75, 430, 375]; p004_03 [50, 480, 900, 465]; p004_04 [50, 975, 900, 450]. Keep all art inside these boxes; gutters remain plain paper.
FINAL CONTINUITY: Draw ONLY this page's listed story cast: nil, ama, tobi, collector. Ama: adult dark-brown-skinned mother, patched ochre wax-pattern dress, INDIGO headwrap, ash shawl and laundry basket. Tobi: nine-year-old dark-brown-skinned boy, short black curls, YELLOW oversized hoodie, patched blue jeans, bottlecap charms, no printed numbers. Collector: HUMAN clerk-enforcer, black/brass rigid uniform with peaked cap, mechanical jar; not a demon. Do not add other named characters from style notes or other pages. The priest must NOT appear before the shrine entrance scene. Every mechanical readout is EMPTY SMOKED GLASS, never a portrait mirror; Civic/Audit/NaN lettering is added later. Preserve panel count, geometry and required geography. Clean 4K portrait page, no lettering, no balloons. Broad clean upper panel areas for separate text, faces/hands placed below those zones. Fine controlled ink detail at focal areas; strong black shapes and selective crosshatching; readable painted atmosphere, no glossy photorealism.
